pairs.note: Answer captures the 8% per annum preferred return compounded annually, but omits a required element of the key: the 100% (full) General Partner catch-up following the preferred return. It also drops the basis (on Capital Contributions).

Same substance: ten years from the Final Closing Date, up to two successive one-year extensions requiring Majority in Interest consent. The omitted expiry date (Dec 16, 2034) and the 'as amended by the First Amendment' provenance are supporting detail, not distinct required elements.
